column1: A 400 m² R-2 Basic lot (single-family, BHL 10 m), NO firewall. Maximum AMBF?  (A) 180 m²  (B) 220 m²  (C) 240 m²  (D) 280 m²
column2: KEY: (B) 220 m² — PSO 55% × 400 = 220 m² (no-firewall column). [PD 1096 (2005 Revised IRR), Rule VIII, Table VIII.1]

column1: Same 400 m² R-2 Basic lot, now WITH the one permitted firewall. Maximum footprint?  (A) 220 m²  (B) 240 m²  (C) 260 m²  (D) 180 m²
column2: KEY: (B) 240 m² — With-firewall PSO 60% × 400 = 240 m². [PD 1096 (2005 Revised IRR), Rule VIII, Table VIII.1 notes e/f]

column1: MACA (Maximum Allowable Construction Area) equals:  (A) PSO + TOSL  (B) PSO + ISA  (C) ISA + USA  (D) PSO alone
column2: KEY: (B) PSO + ISA — Note c: MACA = PSO + ISA. (PSO+TOSL = TLA; ISA+USA = TOSL.) [PD 1096 (2005 Revised IRR), Rule VIII, Table VIII.1 note c]

column1: R-2 Maximum lot: the table prints front setback 8.00 m*. For the 3rd floor, the required front setback is:  (A) 8.00 m  (B) 5.00 m  (C) 3.00 m  (D) 4.50 m
column2: KEY: (C) 3.00 m — 8.00 = 3.00 + 5.00 at grade only (parking strip); upper floors revert to 3.00 m (note b). [PD 1096 (2005 Revised IRR), Rule VIII, Table VIII.2 note b]

column1: A 10-storey residential building. Minimum width of the rear court?  (A) 2.00 m  (B) 4.40 m  (C) 5.00 m  (D) 3.00 m
column2: KEY: (B) 4.40 m — 2.00 m + 300 mm × 8 storeys above the 2nd = 4.40 m (increments run to the 14th storey). [PD 1096 (2005 Revised IRR), Rule VIII, Sec. 804.6]

column1: For an R-2 lot, firewalls/abutments are permitted on:  (A) two sides  (B) one side only, never front or rear  (C) no property line at all  (D) two sides and the rear
column2: KEY: (B) one side only, never front or rear — Sec. 804.4.ii: R-2 = one side only; front/rear never. (R-1 none; R-3 two sides or one+rear; R-4 two sides.) [PD 1096 (2005 Revised IRR), Rule VIII, Sec. 804.4]

column1: BP 344 (amended IRR): the general gradient limit for an accessible ramp is:  (A) 1:12  (B) 1:10  (C) 1:20  (D) 1:15
column2: KEY: (C) 1:20 — Appendix A p.17: gradient not steeper than 1:20; steeper only in special cases by length. [BP 344 IRR Amendments, Appendix A, p.17 / Table A.1.1]

column1: BP 344: minimum clear width of an accessible ramp:  (A) 900 mm  (B) 1200 mm  (C) 1500 mm  (D) 800 mm
column2: KEY: (B) 1200 mm — Appendix A.1.2.a: minimum clear width 1200 mm. [BP 344 IRR Amendments, Appendix A, p.17]

column1: BP 344: a ramp at 1:15 may run at most how long before a landing is required?  (A) 6.00 m  (B) 15.00 m  (C) 10.50 m  (D) 0.70 m
column2: KEY: (C) 10.50 m — Table A.1.1: 1:15 → max length 10.50 m (max rise 700 mm, landing interval 10 m). [BP 344 IRR Amendments, Table A.1.1]

column1: A Com-2 lot WITH firewall: maximum allowable PSO?  (A) 75%  (B) 80%  (C) 85%  (D) 90%
column2: KEY: (C) 85% — Table VIII.1: Com-2 = 75 (no firewall) / 85 (with firewall). [PD 1096 (2005 Revised IRR), Rule VIII, Table VIII.1]
